entries.prompt: Correct ONLY the tiny upper-center crown silhouette of the SECOND isolated Scar PHG HuntingParty3 mask. FIRST official group render is source authority; relevant character is CENTER only. The actual source crown has TWO SHORT blunt upper rim tips with a SMALL SHALLOW U-shaped depression between them. It is NOT one continuous round closed top. Restore that true source upper outline: small gap/dip about2–3percent of total visible mask height,roughly20–25percent of crown width between the tiny tips,as seen in FIRST. This is a shallow rim termination/notch at the very TOP,not a deep opening through the forehead and not tall horns. Preserve the central dome just below the shallow source notch; invent no rear shell/interior or hidden depth. Do not make a flat crop across the full top. Keep every other part of SECOND unchanged: exact source downward-inclined near-front camera and projected asymmetry,whole sides/eyes/cheeks/muzzle/chin,the SAME source pale two-stroke forehead scar-mark in its exact location and shape,EXACTLY THREE small red temple lenses in the same image-left triangle,black opaque eye inserts,original silver/gray material,wear,and source blue/red local lighting. Do not introduce another character's design,new marks,vents,runes,LEDs or hardware. No symmetry/new front/profile/back or geometry redesign. Exclude biology/living eyes/mandibles,dreads/hair rings,neck,body/armor,weapons,other figures and scene. Exactly one complete isolated hard mask,genuine transparent RGBA,10percent clear transparent margins,whole crown tips and chin unclipped,longest axis78-80percent canvas,no background,floor,shadow plane,emitted glow,UI or text. Only restore the small real shallow U and two tiny upper rim endpoints; leave glyph and lens triplet untouched.
